title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth, BBC finds
description: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

title: Rejecting closer EU ties would be dereliction of duty, PM to say
description: Addressing the Commons, Burnham is expected to say that a new deal with the EU could help tackle illegal immigration and boost economic growth.

title: Russell Brand arrives at court for start of rape trial
description: The 51-year-old actor and comedian denies charges of rape and sexual assault against six women.

title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
description: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.

title: Reform pledges to suspend asylum system for up to five years and deport claimants
description: All asylum applications would be rejected and existing ones voided, with all claimants marked for deportation.

title: Watch moment orangutan family released back into the wild after Borneo fires
description: The critically endangered apes were rescued from intense wildfires that destroyed their habitat in August and September.

title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
description: He says voters were not "sufficiently" informed about how foreign actors sought to disrupt UK democracy.

title: Wildlife park closed for third day after tiger attack
description: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains shut after a man was fatally attacked by a tiger on Saturday.

title: Healey faces £35bn Budget challenge to meet spending pledges, says think tank
description: The Institute for Fiscal Studies says the government will need a "top-up" of billions of pounds if it wants to meet its spending plans.
